tool.read_file.desc: Read a file's content from the local file system
tool.read_image.desc: Read a local image file and attach it to the tool result so the model can actually see it
tool.write_file.desc: Write plain text content to a file
tool.edit_file.desc: Edit a text file by replacing a specific string
tool.file_system_overview.desc: Get an overview of the local file system
tool.memory.desc: Manage memory in conversations. Supports add, delete, and search
tool.ask_user.desc: Ask the user a question and wait for their answer, optionally with choices
tool.codeact_csharp.desc: Execute C# code that can call every tool enabled for this round, attach images, observe cancellation and access the conversation environment
tool.variable.desc: Manage variables in conversations. Supports get, set, delete, list, and search
tool.web_search.desc: Search the live web through the configured web search service
tool.web_fetch.desc: Fetch the text content of a URL (only offered by some search services)
tool.generate_image.desc: Generate an image through a configured ComfyUI or A1111 endpoint and return /userimages/ links that can be embedded in the reply
tool.creator_agent.desc: Create, list, inspect, update and delete agents, and read or replace their private pipeline trees (pre-generation / post-generation / render modifier)
tool.creator_node_catalog.desc: List every available pipeline node type with its property metadata, and list the registered tools
tool.creator_preset.desc: List, inspect, create, update and delete pre-generation / post-generation / render modifier presets
panel_toolmanager.title: Tool Manager
panel_toolmanager.available_tools_desc: Enable tools here, then use Tool Preset node in Generation Manager to load them.
panel_tool_manager.desc: Save tool enablement profiles for different scenarios; nodes load them by preset.
